title: Verification-Guided Retrosynthesis: Reaction Feedback and Evidence Timing
abstract: arXiv:2610.38245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrosynthesis planning seeks synthesis routes from purchasable starting materials to a target molecule. Search over predicted reactions can connect a target to available materials, yet an infeasible reaction can invalidate the resulting route. Evaluating route quality only after search has finished cannot correct errors made during search. We introduce Verification-Guided Reflow (VGR), incorporating reaction verification as a decision action in AND/OR search. Verification results are represented as binary verdicts; queries are scheduled from the search structure, and acquired verdicts exclude reactions or adjust search priorities. We define verified solvability as the fraction of targets for which a complete route accepted stepwise by the verifier is found. On Retro190, feeding verification results into search increases verified solvability from 51.1% to 62.6% relative to route evaluation without feedback. Further controlled experiments

translated_title: 验证引导的逆合成：反应反馈与证据时机
translated_abstract: 逆合成规划旨在寻找从可购买起始原料到目标分子的合成路线。在预测反应上进行搜索可以将目标分子与可用原料连接起来，但一个不可行的反应可能会使由此得到的路线失效。仅在搜索结束后评估路线质量无法纠正搜索过程中产生的错误。我们提出验证引导重流，将反应验证作为AND/OR搜索中的一种决策动作纳入其中。验证结果以二元判定表示；查询依据搜索结构进行调度，所获得的判定结果可排除某些反应或调整搜索优先级。我们定义“验证可解性”为找到完整路线且该路线被验证器逐步接受的目标分子比例。在Retro190基准上，将验证结果反馈到搜索中，使验证可解性相对于无反馈的路线评估从51.1%提升至62.6%。进一步的受控实验表明……
tldr: 将反应验证作为AND/OR搜索中的决策动作，通过实时反馈验证结果来排除不可行反应或调整搜索优先级，将逆合成的验证可解性从51.1%提升至62.6%。
en_tdlr: Incorporating reaction verification as a decision action in AND/OR search, with verification feedback used to exclude infeasible reactions or adjust search priorities, raises verified solvability from 51.1% to 62.6%.
